title: Reform Should Cut Back Britain’s State Pension, Think Tank Says
summary: A think tank linked to Reform UK has suggested that Nigel Farage’s party should reduce the state pension to a means-tested safety net, if it comes to power.

title: India's Dixon Tech Eyes Growth Beyond Smartphones
summary: Sunil Vachani , the Executive Chairman of Dixon Technologies expects the company's EMS rankings to be in the top 5 in the next decade. In an exclusive conversation with BTV's Menaka Doshi, he adds that the company is eyeing growth beyond smartphones to add global clout. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Asian Stocks Set to Extend Gains as Tech Rallies: Markets Wrap
summary: Asian stocks were poised to extend their winning streak after chipmakers drove the Nasdaq 100 to its first record since June, while falling oil prices provided a further boost amid hopes for progress toward ending the war with Iran.

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 23
summary: Oil extended losses as the US flagged progress in talks with Iran to end their war, and Saudi Arabia moved to restart a key pipeline.

title: Apollo Caps Private Credit Fund Again as 14.7% Look to Exit
summary: Apollo Global Management Inc. is limiting redemptions from a private credit fund for the third straight quarter, as its investors join the rush to pull cash from the $1.8 trillion direct lending market.
